description: This file defines control interfaces, enums, and data structures for the AOM (Alliance for Open Media) video codec, specifically for the AV1 codec. It includes control IDs, post-processing flags, and reference frame structures used for encoding and decoding operations.

classes.name: aom_postproc_cfg
classes.description: Structure defining post-processing configuration including flags, deblocking level, and noise level.

classes.name: av1_ref_frame
classes.description: Structure representing AV1 reference frame data, including index, external reference flag, and image data.

methods.name: AOM_CTRL_USE_TYPE
methods.description: Macro used to associate control IDs with their parameter data types.
